answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after a long season of verified, useful work, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. Like a tide that tests every hull before dawn, the network watches early behavior: new identities earn only tiny limits, and any fraud slashes the stake and echoes through a shared reputation record, so an attacker must pay again and again for every fake while honest agents keep one cheap, trusted identity.
